blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
What This Course Is Really About
This course is about one clear idea.

Right now, your portfolio sits still. You can look at it, but you cannot really use it. Click a button, and nothing happens. Open a menu, and nothing moves. Fill a form, and nothing responds.That is about to change.

items: When someone clicks a button, something should happen.
When they open a menu, it should open and close smoothly.
When they fill out a form, the site should guide them if something is missing.

blocks.content: Small, clear ideas that you can understand and control.
By the end, you will take the portfolio you already built and make it feel alive. You don't need to memorize everything. You just need to get comfortable with the pattern.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
